none: PAS CAM-F8AF15: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend - no legend. Reverse shows Victory on prow. Mint is Trier, AD 330-335. Obverse legend reads CONSTAN-TINOPOLIS. Obverse shows Helmeted bust left with sceptre over shoulder. Reverse fields and exergue read: (branch)/ //TRS. Die axis is 5 o'clock. Weight is 2.26g, diameter is 17.8mm, thickness is 1.8mm
